questions.q:
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?author (COUNT(?b) AS ?books) WHERE {
  ?b schema:author ?a . ?a rdfs:label ?author
}
GROUP BY ?author
ORDER BY DESC(?books)
LIMIT 20
